edges.reason: msg.sender enters _transfer as the sender address via _msgSender().
unlock authorization depends on msg.sender matching _previousOwner.
constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router call.
unlock compares now against _lockTime to gate ownership restoration.
lock stores _lockTime = now + time, making lock duration timestamp dependent.
_transfer delegates the final balance movement to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the contract balance exceeds the swap threshold.
_transfer sends ETH out to team wallets before finishing the token transfer accounting.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with contract tokens.
The external router call can re-enter the transfer flow before state is settled.
sendETHToTeam pushes native ETH to external payable addresses.
Native transfer recipients may re-enter _transfer while it is mid-execution.
_tokenTransfer invokes _takeTeam on each transfer variant.
_tokenTransfer invokes _reflectFee on each transfer variant.
_tokenTransfer obtains r/t amounts from _getValues.
_takeTeam credits the contract's _rOwned balance with the team reflection amount.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal, an unchecked invariant-sensitive subtraction.
swapTokensForEth uses the uniswapV2Router state variable for the swap.
sendETHToTeam transfers half the amount to _teamWalletAddress.
sendETHToTeam transfers half the amount to _marketingWalletAddress.
manualSend forwards the contract ETH balance to sendETHToTeam.
manualSwap forwards the contract token balance to swapTokensForEth.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee for sender and recipient to decide takeFee.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount cap on transfers.
_transfer compares the contract balance against _numOfTokensToExchangeForTeam.
_transfer checks sender against the uniswapV2Pair address to avoid circular swaps.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before initiating a swap.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard flag.
The lockTheSwap modifier on swapTokensForEth toggles inSwap.
_tokenTransfer branches on _isExcluded for sender and recipient.
constructor uses msg.sender as the deployer/owner identity.
constructor initializes the _owner state variable.
constructor assigns the Uniswap router to uniswapV2Router.
unlock restores _owner from the stored previous owner.
unlock reads and compares _previousOwner.
unlock gates on now > _lockTime, a timestamp dependency.
lock clears _owner to address(0).
lock stores the current owner into _previousOwner.
lock writes _lockTime using the current block timestamp.
_setTaxFee writes the _taxFee state variable.
sender parameter drives the _transfer authorization and balance updates.
recipient parameter drives the _transfer balance updates.
amount parameter drives the _transfer value computations.
tokenAmount parameter is the amount swapped in swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter is the ETH amount split in sendETHToTeam.
tAmount parameter is the token amount processed by _tokenTransfer.
tTeam parameter is the reflection amount converted in _takeTeam.
_transfer derives the contractTokenBalance local from balanceOf(address(this)).
_transfer derives the takeFee local from the fee exclusion mappings.
swapTokensForEth builds the local path array used for the router swap.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's flow and merges into that core function.
The recipient parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's flow and merges into that core function.
The amount parameter is only meaningful as part of _transfer's flow and merges into that core function.
The local is computed and consumed entirely inside _transfer and merges into it.
The takeFee local is produced in _transfer and passed onward, so it merges into _transfer.
The tokenAmount parameter exists solely for the swapTokensForEth swap call.
The path array is built and used only inside swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is used only to split ETH in sendETHToTeam.
The tAmount parameter is used only to drive the transfer dispatch in _tokenTransfer.
The tTeam parameter is used only for the reflection credit in _takeTeam.
